guard.noSources_one: Refusing to overwrite “{{file}}”: this project has no documents, but the file holds {{count}} document. This usually means a fault cleared the documents after the file was opened. Use Save Project As to save it to a new file if you really want to save an empty project.
guard.noSources_other: Refusing to overwrite “{{file}}”: this project has no documents, but the file holds {{count}} documents. This usually means a fault cleared the documents after the file was opened. Use Save Project As to save it to a new file if you really want to save an empty project.

guard.missingFiles_one: Refusing to save “{{file}}”: the contents of {{count}} imported document couldn’t be found ({{names}}). They weren’t in memory, the temporary cache or the existing project file, so saving now would save it empty. Import the document again and try again.

codeFreq.howIntro: Each cell shows the proportion of one source covered by one code, expressed as a percentage. The denominator depends on the source kind:
codeFreq.howText: Text / Markdown: % of characters covered (overlapping codings counted once).
codeFreq.howMedia: Audio / Video: % of duration covered by the union of time-range codings.
codeFreq.howPdfRegion: PDF (region codings): % of region selections coded with this code.
codeFreq.howPdfMixed: PDF (mixed): weighted average of the two above, by the count of each kind of selection in the source.
codeFreq.howImage: Image: % of region selections coded with this code.

zotero.notRunning: Magnolia can’t reach Zotero. Open Zotero on this computer, then try again.
zotero.disabled: Zotero isn’t letting other apps read its library. In Zotero, open Settings, choose Advanced, and tick “Allow other applications on this computer to communicate with Zotero”. Then try again.
zotero.tooOld: This version of Zotero can’t share its library. Magnolia needs Zotero 7 or later.
zotero.unsupportedFile: Magnolia can’t import this kind of file
